title: salvia neohispanica
intro: Salvia neohispanica, commonly known as Mexican Sage, is a flowering plant species within the sage family (Lamiaceae). This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, making it a popular choice for natural remedies. Salvia neohispanica has been reported to exhibit therapeutic actions such as improving cognitive function, reducing stress, and promoting relaxation due to its ability to interact with the brain's opioid receptors. The bioactive constituents of Salvia neohispanica include salvinorin A, a potent natural compound that has been shown to have neuroprotective and anxiolytic effects.
